info.bio:
Supergrass fue una banda de rock inglesa, formada en Oxford, Reino Unido en 1993, fuertemente influenciado por los grandes nombres del rock británico como The Beatles, The Kinks, T. Rex y Buzzcocks.

Los orígenes del grupo parten de una banda primigenia llamada The Jennifers (no confundir con la banda americana del mismo nombre) formada en la Wheatley Park School, en la que estaban enrolados Coombes (16 años) como vocalista y Goffey (18 años)como batería.

scenes.name: Brit-pop y post-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Como tantas veces, el fenómeno más publicitado es el menos interesante: un «brit-pop» de grupos terriblemente parecidos y tediosos, sin apenas imaginación. Lo anticipan Lightning Seeds, La's, Teenage Fanclub y Heavenly; estalla con Boo Radleys, Blur (Parklife) y Oasis (el «farol» que mejor personifica la moda). Suede y el glam-pop (Super Furry Animals, Placebo), las excepciones de High Llamas (Hawaii) y Supergrass, el revival mod (Ocean Colour Scene, Wildhearts), Elastica, Sleeper, las Spice Girls; Trembling Blue Stars, Tindersticks, Delgados. El post-pop de Radiohead, «la banda más publicitada y sobrevalorada de la década», cuyo OK Computer es una obra maestra del falso vanguardismo; Coldplay, Travis.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …Wilson-style arranger on the first two albums by the High Llamas (1), Gideon Gaye (1995) and especially the ambitious and monumental Hawaii (1996). xref.title: Post-Graduation Concerts (1991)
xref.body: The band's first concert after their graduation period took place on July 22, 1991, at the Hollywood in Oxford. Despite having played together "off and on for years" and estimated "at least 100 times" before, this gig was described as relatively modest: "five friends, two strobe lights and a smoke machine." A subsequent gig in October at the Jericho Tavern, known for hosting other Oxford bands like Supergrass, Ride, and Slowdive, proved to be a turning point. "The big day that everybody remembers is July 22, 1991. Just when they played a show at the Hollywood in Oxford, their first post-graduation concert."

xref.title: The Recurring Couch Motif
xref.body: A specific rented couch became a distinctive and recurring visual element for The Cranberries' album artwork. It appeared on the covers of their debut album, "Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?" (1993), their second album, "No Need to Argue" (1994), and surprisingly, their 2017 unplugged album, "Something Else." The same couch also made a cameo in the 1996 music video for the Supergrass song "Alright." "The couch disappeared from the Cranberries world until 2017 when it appeared on the cover of the unplugged album."
